title: CurlingMania
description: A 2D multiplayer curling-inspired web game. The main mechanic is physics based.

title: Battle Thunder
description: A 3D multiplayer plane dogfighting web game. You can also play single player against AI planes, or add them to multiplayer games.

title: E-Money's Bar
description: A 2D multiplayer bluffing card game based on the card game "BS".

title: WebSend
description: An encrypted peer-to-peer file sharing website that transfers files directly between devices using WebRTC, without passing through a server.

title: Moon Lander Game
description: A simple 2D moon lander simulator I built using DeepSeek R1 to test out its capabilities.

title: Cogtest
description: 5 brain "benchmarking" mini-games that test your reaction speed, pattern recognition, focus, and memory.
